content.text:
**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 19 of the MSA satisfies the preferred WARRANTY position on every material term:

| Playbook element | Document |
|---|---|
| Professional and workmanlike | § 19.1 — plus qualified personnel, industry standards, Agreement and Order Form |
| Conformance to documentation | § 19.1 / § 19.2 — 90 days from the **later** of delivery or acceptance for Deliverables; hosted Services conform **throughout the subscription term** |
| Repair / replace / refund | § 19.4 — prompt re-performance, repair or replacement at no charge, then terminate-and-refund of Fees paid; non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims |
| Compliance with laws | § 19.3 (reinforced by § 3.1 and § 26.1) |
| No malicious code | § 19.3, plus no functionality diminution and open-source protection |
| Disclaimer does not swallow warranty | § 19.5 — mutual, limited to implied warranties, and expressly preserves express warranties, service levels, indemnities and stated remedies |

The hosted-Services warranty running for the whole term is better than the preferred 12-month software benchmark, and § 6.2 gives an independent reject-and-refund path at acceptance. Nothing here binds us adversely, so there is no basis to redline.
